_about: Intentional, audited divergences from the verbatim v1 content. The reference sections (src/content/sections/*.html), the live calculator subsystem (src/ui/calculators-live.mjs) and the framework-chart node files (src/content/nodes/<income>/<marker>.json) are generated from main:v1/flowchart.html and are held byte-identical to it by gates 9, 10 and 8, so a figure that goes stale there cannot be fixed by editing those files. Targets: 'section:<view>', 'calculators-live', 'node:<income>/<marker>' (a node correction applies to its detailsHtml only). Each entry below is applied by tools/build-v2.mjs on top of the verbatim text at build time; tools/verify-corrections.mjs (gate 13) proves every 'find' still matches the verbatim source exactly 'count' times, so a v1 change or a silent drift fails the build. Tokens in 'replace': {{fig:key}} -> the figure's display string, {{figval:key}} -> its raw number. Hand-typed derived numbers carry the derivation in 'reason'. Every entry names the audit claim it corrects and the primary source read on 'verified'.
_retired: COR-001..005 (the dependent-care FSA $5,000 → $7,500 correction, claim CL186) were applied here from 2026-11-06 until main:v1/flowchart.html itself was corrected on the owner's decision the same day (main edb4b3e). After that the verbatim sources carry $7,500 and the entries were removed; the mechanism stays for the next stale figure.
